title: The Add site wizard follows 409 USE_SHARD (redirect) and 503 SHARD_FULL (createAt) to the server that keeps the person's sites, and follows only an absolute https URL the door sent
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd`; it replaces fetch and calls the real createSite of packages/site/tracy-add-site/src/client/create.ts. No database, no server.
S2: A 409 USE_SHARD with redirect https://s1.tracy.ai/new/ answers {refusal: elsewhere, url}; a 503 SHARD_FULL with createAt answers the same shape.
S3: A redirect that is relative, http:, javascript: or scheme-relative, or missing, answers {refusal: other} with no url; a USE_SHARD on 503 or a SHARD_FULL on 409 is not believed.
S4: TAKEN, HOST_UPDATING and NOT_SIGNED_IN answer as before.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.
No outcome carries a url that is not an absolute https URL.
fence: The wizard only ever navigates to an absolute https URL that the create door itself returned on its own status (409 USE_SHARD, 503 SHARD_FULL); a relative, http:, javascript: or scheme-relative target is refused as a plain error with no url. Pure client logic with a fake fetch, no network.

tests: 409 USE_SHARD with a redirect is elsewhere, with that url
503 SHARD_FULL with createAt is elsewhere too, read before the 5xx rule
a url that is not an absolute https one is not followed: the refusal is other, with no url
the codes are believed only on their own status (doorCode): a 503 USE_SHARD or a 409 SHARD_FULL decides nothing
the refusals of today are untouched beside the new one
elsewhereUrl keeps an absolute https URL and nothing else
